subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• NOAA research mission Atlas-7 took place from January 12, 2023, to May 8, 2023.
• Marine scientists Dr. Raj Reddy and Dr. Hannah Reed were team members on Atlas-7.
• March 15, 2023: Reddy and Osei conducted a submersible dive to deploy sensors near hydrothermal vents in the Mariana Trench.
• A submersible dive (also known as a deep-sea descent) is an activity done by researchers in a specialized underwater vehicle.
• The duration of their dive was 9 hours and 42 minutes.
• Theirs is counted among the longest completed deep-sea dives to date.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize the duration of Reddy and Osei's submersible dive. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Lasting 9 hours and 42 minutes, Reddy and Osei's submersible dive is one of the longest deep-sea dives completed to date.
choices.B: Reddy and Osei completed a submersible dive, also known as a deep-sea descent, in which they used a specialized underwater vehicle to deploy sensors near hydrothermal vents in the Mariana Trench.
choices.C: During their time as team members on Atlas-7, Reddy and Osei completed a submersible dive.
choices.D: The submersible dive completed by Atlas-7 team members Reddy and Osei took place from January 12, 2023, to May 8, 2023.

explanation: Choice A is the best answer because it most effectively emphasizes the duration of the submersible dive. The sentence opens with 'Lasting 9 hours and 42 minutes,' immediately foregrounding the temporal information and drawing attention to how long the dive lasted. This choice also contextualizes the duration's significance by noting that the dive 'is one of the longest deep-sea dives completed to date,' which reinforces why this particular time span deserves emphasis. By structuring the sentence to lead with duration and then explaining its exceptional nature, this choice directly accomplishes the stated rhetorical goal.
